title: Cobblemon RLM
description: A Cobblemon datapack adding regional forms as well as fakemon to Cobblemon.
body:
---

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/GC58bFHM?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=Downloads&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/project/cobblemon-rlm) [![Game Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-62B47A?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft)](https://minecraft.net) [![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wiki-Pok%C3%A9dex-3B82F6?style=for-the-badge)](https://antredesloutres.fr/pokemon/wiki/pokedex/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-EF4444?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)
--- ## 🦦 What is Cobblemon RLM? **Cobblemon RLM** is a datapack / mod for **[Cobblemon](https://cobblemon.com)** created by the **Antre des Loutres** team. It enriches your adventure with **original regional forms**, **unique Fakemons**, **new exclusive abilities** and **Mega Evolutions** from the **Royaume de Loutre Mer** (RLM) universe. > Compatible with **Fabric** and **NeoForge** — available as `.jar` (mod) and `.zip` (datapack). --- ## Pack Contents ### RLM Regional Forms | Pokémon | Typing | Pre-evolution | |---------|--------|---------------| | **Meganium** | Grass / Steel | Bayleef (Grass) | | **Blastoise** | Water / Flying | Wartortle (Water) | | **Empoleon** | Water / Electric | Prinplup (Water) | | **Delphox** | Fire / Fairy | Braixen (Fire) | | **Ampharos** | Electric / Ghost | Flaaffy, Mareep | | **Probopass** | Rock / Fairy | Nosepass | | **Spiritomb** | Fire / Dark | — | | **Luxray** | Ice | Luxio, Shinx | | **Togekiss** | Fairy / Dragon | — | | **Ninjask** | Water / Flying | Nincada (Bug / Water) | | **Shedinja** | Water / Rock | — | | **Mawile** | Poison / Fairy *or* Dragon / Fairy | Smowile (Fairy) | | **Sunflora** | Sky: Grass / Flying · Ocean: Grass / Water · Volcano: Grass / Fire | — | ### Original Fakemons | Pokémon | Typing | Notes | |---------|--------|-------| | **Flammiko** | Fire / Electric | — | | **Apheos** & **Aphelis** | Fairy / Flying | — | | **Rineshell** | Normal | Evolves into Galama | | **Galama** | Steel / Normal | — | | **Kotora** | Electric / Fairy | — | | **Tinywone** | Bug | Evolves into Wamek | | **Wamek** | Bug / Fighting | — | | **Smowile** | Fairy | Mawile's Pre-evolution | ### Exclusive Abilities | Ability | Effect | |---------|--------| | **Dragonate** | Transforms Normal-type moves into Dragon-type. | | **Dullness Guard** | Protects from all moves except those that are "not very effective". | | **Marine Vortex** | Summons rain upon entry. Under rain: Attack and Sp. Atk ×1.5. | | **Mystiforce** | Special Attack is doubled. | | **Psycho-Prio** | Priority on attacks as long as HP is above 50%. | | **Venom Armor** | Sp. Def +50% and 50% chance to badly poison on contact. | ### RLM Mega Evolutions > *Requires [Cobblemon: Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/project/mega-showdown)* | Pokémon | Typing | Ability | |---------|--------|---------| | **Mega Ampharos RLM** | Electric / Fire | — | | **Mega Flammiko** | Fire / Electric | Simple | | **Mega Mawile** (Poison) | Poison / Fairy | Venom Armor | | **Mega Mawile** (Dragon) | Dragon / Fairy | Mystiforce | | **Mega Wamek** | Bug / Dragon | Dragonate | --- ## 📥 Installation ### As a Mod (recommended) 1. Download the **`.jar`** file from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/cobblemon-rlm). 2. Place it in your **`mods/`** folder. 3. Launch Minecraft with **Fabric** or **NeoForge**. ### As a Datapack 1. Download the **`.zip`** file from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/cobblemon-rlm). 2. Place it in your world's **`datapacks/`** folder. ### Requirements - [**Cobblemon**](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) (required) - [**Cobblemon: Mega Showdown**](https://modrinth.com/project/mega-showdown) (optional, for Mega Evolutions) --- ## 👥 Credits | | | |---|---| | **Project** | [Antre des Loutres](https://antredesloutres.fr) | | **Design & Development** | [TheAzertor](https://github.com/Corentin-cott) · [RereBleue](https://github.com/matheo-1712) | | **Base Models & Textures** | [Cobblemon](https://cobblemon.com) | ---
